scripts.format:cpp: find node/compute/native-cpp/src node/compute/support -type f \( -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.hpp' \) -exec clang-format -i {} + && clang-format -i node/compute/native-cpp/bench_main.h node/compute/native-cpp/json_util.h node/apps/raw-http-hello/cpp-epoll/server.cpp node/apps/raw-http-hello/cpp-drogon/main.cc
scripts.format:cpp:check: find node/compute/native-cpp/src node/compute/support -type f \( -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.hpp' \) -exec clang-format --dry-run --Werror {} + && clang-format --dry-run --Werror node/compute/native-cpp/bench_main.h node/compute/native-cpp/json_util.h node/apps/raw-http-hello/cpp-epoll/server.cpp node/apps/raw-http-hello/cpp-drogon/main.cc
